What changed between two published Players Committee images of [[Kir Kanos (V)]]: left, the image of [[Kir Kanos (V)]] (holotable commit 022435b); right, the image of [[Kir Kanos (V) (Errata)]] (holotable commit d5f24d6). Both crops are cut from the published images ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif before], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d5f24d6dd023e0aba39bc2f530e19465496ebf25/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Dark/large/kirkanos.gif after]) with their pixels unchanged; only the white label strip is added.
